usb.text: Shared USB: cold mode changes only. Unplug power before moving the single MODE shunt.
Physical recovery: selected BOOT held low, peer held RESET. SW1/SW3 are independent resets.

power.text: USB-C sink only. >=1.5 A advertised required. No Amiga supply connection to these rails.
POWER REVIEW OPEN: CC downgrade, input protection and thermal/capacitor derating. Not fabrication-ready.

rp.text: 48 GPIO: address/data/control only; USB and SWD dedicated pads. GPIO45 IRQ; GPIO46 BUS_READY.
Core regulator placement MUST follow Raspberry Pi reference, including marked inductor orientation.
C26-C36: IOVDD/ADC/USB/QSPI decoupling. C37-C39: DVDD. Place at corresponding package pads.

esp.text: N16R8 module includes flash, PSRAM, crystal and RF. IO35/36/37 are reserved for octal PSRAM.
Antenna at enclosure/PCB edge: apply Espressif all-layer antenna keepout before PCB placement.

address.text: 86-contact A500 socket; NOT the existing male PCB-edge footprint. No A2000 SLAVE/CFGOUT here.
U40-U43 use pin-compatible 541 logic symbol; fitted part MUST be 3.3V SN74LVC541A (5V tolerant, Ioff).

data.text: Upper row: RP -> Amiga. Lower row: Amiga -> RP. Byte enables independent; hardware read/write qualification.
PIO: preload read data/direction, pulse DATA_DRIVE, settle, pulse ACK_REQ. Return GPIO to input between cycles.

control.text: Host monitor: 0.405V x 11 = 4.455V nominal trip; CT open = 20ms release delay. No host supply drawn for operation.
XRDY wait starts in hardware for E80000-EFFFFF; rising ACK_REQ releases this cycle. No local DTACK driver.
U84/U86 clear between cycles: stale ACK/DATA_DRIVE cannot carry into next cycle. BERR disables all outputs.

input.text: USB VBUS -> current/voltage protection -> reverse-blocking ideal diode -> AON and qualified main supply.
681R: nominal 1.337A limit. OVLO nominal 5.688V. Latch-off thermal fault: unplug USB to recover.
No Amiga supply connection. E-fuse pad/package and fast overvoltage transient review required before layout.

generator_status: Historical whole-board generators are obsolete; do not run. Phase1 uses incremental edits.
